name: io.github.BlazingCDN/blazingcdn-mcp
description: Manage BlazingCDN from AI agents: CDN zones, cache, metrics, domains, cloud storage and video CDN

environmentVariables.name: BLAZINGCDN_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: BlazingCDN API token (panel: client.blazingcdn.com/api, create new API credentials)

environmentVariables.name: BLAZINGCDN_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Allow changes: true lets the agent create and change CDN settings

environmentVariables.name: BLAZINGCDN_ALLOW_DELETE
environmentVariables.description: Allow deleting: true lets the agent delete custom domains and Video CDN resources
